payload.title: Automatically register and bind agent sessions
payload.description: Detect supported Claude Code CLI, Claude Desktop/Cowork, and Codex session lifecycle signals. Automatically register a stable Scope agent, bind the real provider session, renew presence while active, rebind resumed sessions without duplicates, and mark ended sessions offline/release leases. Start with an evidence-backed host capability matrix; implement only supported lifecycle integrations, with truthful mailbox-only fallback. Acceptance: a newly started supported session appears connected without a manual scope agent register/bridge bind, receives an addressed wake-up, survives resume, and becomes offline after termination without leaking provider session identifiers into shared events.
